root_cause_analysis: In 2023, for record CY_0032835 (Nagpur district, Umred taluka, Mandarin Orange), the model predicted a yield of 103.68 q/ha, while the actual realized yield was only 10.73 q/ha (over-prediction error of +92.95 q/ha). Regional rainfall and soil health indicators suggested normal crop vigor. However, this farm suffered an uncaptured localized micro-event (e.g. sudden pink bollworm infestation or intense unseasonal localized hailstorm) that decimated flowering without triggering macro weather station alerts.
operational_guardrails_and_mitigation: Trigger human-in-the-loop inspection when predicted procurement exceeds historical district yield by > 20%.
Integrate high-resolution 10-meter Sentinel-2 NDVI satellite vegetative anomaly alerts to detect localized pest/hail damage 3 weeks before harvest.
Apply a 10% safety discount margin on forward procurement commitments in rainfed zones prone to localized pest clusters.
